title: Tab (Contract B: guitar logic -> UI / database)
description: String/fret guitar tab data, produced only by guitar-logic modules (e.g. tuttut) from Contract A notes. The UI and database only ever read this shape.

tuning.description: Open-string pitches, low string first, as MIDI note numbers. Standard guitar tuning (E2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4) is [40, 45, 50, 55, 59, 64].

string.description: Index into the tuning array, 0 = lowest string.

technique.description: Optional. Absent means a plain picked/plucked note.
